Chat completion via Azure OpenAI with the azure/ prefix for provider routing — verifies the prefix is stripped before dispatching and the response is normalised to the standard OpenAI chat completion shape

```swift title="Swift"
import Foundation
import LiterLlm

let _req = try LiterLlm.chatCompletionRequestFromJson("{\"max_tokens\":16,\"messages\":[{\"content\":\"Say hello\",\"role\":\"user\"}],\"model\":\"azure/gpt-4\",\"temperature\":0}")
guard let _apiKey = ProcessInfo.processInfo.environment["API_KEY"] else { fatalError("API_KEY must be set") }
let _client = try createClient(apiKey: _apiKey, baseUrl: nil)
let result = try await _client.chat(_req)
debugPrint(result.choices())
debugPrint(result.choices()[0].message().content() as Any)
debugPrint(result.choices()[0].finishReason() as Any)
debugPrint(result.model())
debugPrint(result.usage()?.totalTokens() as Any)
```
